This plot is very small, so I will not buy a whole bag of chemical fertilizer for it. I will use the compost and household waste manure I can gather, and I will plant the cassava stems and other planting material I already trust because that is what has worked for me here. I will depend on rain, do my weeding by hand with family help, and keep cash for the bigger plots and for the house.
